instruction: Candid documentary medium shot from a low angle in a ballet studio with concrete walls and wooden barres. The young girl in a black leotard (R1) arches her back while lying on her stomach, head tilted down and arms raised high. Kneeling behind her, the blonde instructor in a black long-sleeve top (R2) holds the young girl's wrists to guide her arms upward and backward, looking down with a focused expression. Soft natural light from the background windows illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows on the floor.
